answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The whisper edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 104 clones produces a signature the lantern analysis flags immediately. An adversary must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, and as a result doing work rather than printing keys, and the ivory settlement applies the void retroactively. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
